core_concepts: About the Author Seth Godin has walked this walk
He is the author of nineteen international bestsellers translated into more than thirty-five languages, including Tribes, Purple Cow, Linchpin, The Dip and This Is Marketing
He writes daily at Seths.blog, which is one of the most popular blogs in the world
He’s started successful companies, taught millions of people and left his mark on our creative culture
He’s also the founder of the altMBA and the Akimbo Workshops, online seminars that have transformed the work of thousands of people
He writes about the post-industrial revolution, the way ideas spread, marketing, quitting, leadership and most of all, changing everything
